note: Attala County's ArcGIS service (attalams) has parcels, school, tax and city boundary layers but no zoning districts layer; parcel attributes carry no zoning field. The City of Kosciusko, the only city with a zoning ordinance found, publishes its official zoning map only as a PDF (2017, districts A-1 to I-2), with no queryable service. No county zoning districts were found; a statewide MARIS search found none.
